purpose: Candidate base screw / washer / tapped-bed geometry; not a verified connection capacity

calculator.evidenceMethod: Manually transcribed visible live calculator inputs and outputs via browser; not a downloaded native calculation file or an independently implemented VDI solver
conditions: The publisher's through-hole option requires at least 2 pitches of screw protrusion. The proposed physically through-tapped bed has a recessed screw tip; use the Blind Hole calculation option.
Theoretical material-database comparison for developing full bolt strength, not an allowable working load or project material certificate.
Run-in, run-out, chamfers and imperfect threads reduce engagement. The observed Blind Hole cases deduct 3 pitches (7.5 mm). Confirm actual effective full threads by drawing and inspection.
No preload, tightening torque, wear, repeated use, fatigue or whole-bed resistance is established. Manufacturer testing/verification remains necessary.

washerSource.compatibility: Publisher states suitable with screw property classes <=8.8; this does not prove the project washer bending/contact resistance.

methodSeparation: NASA RP1228 was inspected as a separate historical empirical tapped-hole screen. Its area/shear method and the VDI-based manufacturer calculation are not interchangeable; no NASA/VDI/Eurocode hybrid capacity is issued here.
